section: Sticky ATC — show whenever main button is out of viewport
commit_message: fix(pdp): show sticky ATC whenever main add-to-cart button is offscreen
acceptance_criteria: At page load with scroll position 0, if the main add-to-cart button is below the fold, the sticky ATC bar is visible
The sticky ATC bar hides while the main add-to-cart button is in the viewport
The sticky ATC bar shows again after scrolling past the main add-to-cart button
